verdict.rationale: Profiling and data-oriented scaling paths are a fair question for a game engine like PlayCanvas, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a profiler, ECS, a job system, or GPU instancing. The documented entity/component model (rigidbody, collision components) is an adjacent scripting architecture, not a data-oriented ECS or performance-scaling path, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy
